# Grid Render Pipeline — Mental Model

`libs/grid/src/lib/core/internal/`. How a frame is scheduled and how rows/cells reach the DOM — the render half only.

- Resolving/mutating/sorting/aggregating cell VALUES → grid-data-pipeline.md.
- Lifecycle, config precedence, DOM structure, state-ownership matrix → grid-core.md.
- Pointer capture, drag promotion, long-press → grid-input.md.

Read order for a "wrong pixels" bug: render-scheduler (did the phase run?) → virtualization-manager (is the window/spacer right?) → `rows.ts` (did the cell patch?).

## render-scheduler (`core/internal/render-scheduler.ts`)

- OWNS: single-RAF orchestration, phase system, `ready()` promise, one-shot initial resolver.
- PHASES (higher includes lower): STYLE(1) → VIRTUALIZATION(2) → HEADER(3) → ROWS(4) → COLUMNS(5) → FULL(6). Execute DESCENDING 6→1: `mergeConfig → processRows → processColumns → updateTemplate → renderHeader → refreshVirtualWindow → afterRender`.
- INVARIANT: one RAF pending at a time; requests merge to the HIGHEST phase (never downgrade).
- INVARIANT: `mergeConfig` MUST run before `processRows` (plugins register renderers after adapters set `gridConfig`).
- DECIDED: single-RAF batching, not microtask/sync. WHY: prevents layout thrash + races between ResizeObserver, framework updates, scroll.
- DECIDED (May 2026): public `'render'` CustomEvent at end of `#flush()`, after `_schedulerAfterRender` + ready resolvers. Detail `{ phase, initial, rowCount, visibleRange }`, bubbles + composed. WHY: `ready()` is one-shot; consumers need a post-mutation DOM hook. `render-scheduler.ts#dispatchRenderEvent`, `types.ts > RenderDetail`. Tests: `render-scheduler.spec.ts > render event`, `__tests__/integration/render-event.spec.ts`.
  - INVARIANT: NOT dispatched on the disconnected-bail path. Fires on EVERY flush incl. scroll-only renders — gate on `phase >= RenderPhase.ROWS` or `{ once: true }`.
  - RULED OUT: `beforeRender` (plugin hooks cover it), per-row `row-render` (too noisy).

## virtualization-manager (`core/internal/virtualization-manager.ts`)

- OWNS: `VirtualState` (shared mutable): enabled, rowHeight, bypassThreshold, start/end, DOM refs, positionCache, heightCache, geometry cache, averageHeight, measuredCount, scrollMapping.
- INVARIANT: `positionCache` = O(n) array indexed by row index; `null` unless `variableHeights === true`. `heightCache` PERSISTS across positionCache rebuilds (keyed by row identity).
- DECIDED (stage6 coherence): cache ownership tracks `_rows` reference + length. Stale-generation refresh/navigation promotes to the actual force path before reveal; unchanged rows do not rebuild. WHY: property microtasks and reentrant `data-change` precede scheduled cache rebuilds. No scheduler flush, estimated fallback or synchronous new-source focus guarantee. `row-position-coherence.spec.ts`.
- INVARIANT: external visible-band height never substitutes for cached PHYSICAL viewport height in faux-spacer arithmetic. Force refresh updates both physical viewport and scroll-area metrics; mixing generations collapses auto-height content and clamps external scroll on shrink.
- INVARIANT: `start < end`, clamped to `[0, _rows.length]`. Bypass (render all) when `count ≤ bypassThreshold` (default 24).
- FLOW[scroll]: `getRowIndexAtOffset(scrollTop)` (binary search) → start/end → `renderVisibleRows` from row pool.
- TENSION: positionCache rebuilds O(n) on every row-count change (expand/collapse/filter); unmeasured rows use `averageHeight` → jumps until measured.
- DECIDED (Nov 2026, median row-height sampling): `#measureRowHeight` samples EVERY rendered `.data-grid-row`, takes the MEDIAN. WHY: first-row-only let one outlier (editing chrome, wrapping cell) permanently ratchet `state.rowHeight` up. INVARIANT: rows with inline `style="--tbw-row-height: …"` EXCLUDED (intentional overrides). INVARIANT: numeric `gridConfig.rowHeight` short-circuits measurement. `virtualization-manager.ts#measureRowHeight`. Test: `row-height-median-sampling.spec.ts`.
- DECIDED (#479, numeric `rowHeight`): `initializePositionCache` calls only function-valued height configs; plugins also enable variable heights. `configureVariableHeights` re-evaluates numeric gain/change/removal on every merge, sets `#needsRowHeightMeasurement = notFunction && !fixed`, and plugin/base measurement skips configured numbers. `config-manager.#applyPostMergeOperations` writes host `--tbw-row-height`; removal requires `#ownsRowHeightVar` (never erase consumer-owned CSS). Numeric config wins over consumer inline CSS, so density consumers must keep both equal. Use the literal, not a circular `CSS_VARS` import. Test: `variable-row-height.spec.ts > numeric rowHeight combined with a getRowHeight plugin (#479)`.
- DECIDED (Aug 2026, row-height cluster owner): all row-height measurement lives in `virtualization-manager.ts > // #region Row Height Measurement`, NOT `grid.ts` — mutates only `VirtualState` + positionCache. Grid-facing surface = exactly three methods: `configureVariableHeights()`, `afterRenderRowHeights()` (installs first-row `ResizeObserver` once + deferred plugin base-height measure), `disposeRowHeightObserver()`. INVARIANT: keep it at three — public method names are unmanglable bytes in `index.js`; helpers stay `#private`. Seam: `InternalGrid._pluginManager.hasRowHeightPlugin?()`.
- INVARIANT (Sep 2026, deferred plugin base-height latch): `afterRenderRowHeights` spends `#needsRowHeightMeasurement` ONLY after `_bodyEl` has a `.data-grid-row`, and re-arms it when `#measureRowHeightForPlugins` (returns `boolean`) found nothing to measure. Guard-before-latch, mirroring `#setupRowHeightObserver`. WHY: NOTHING re-arms that one-shot — `configureVariableHeights` sets it only inside `if (!s.variableHeights)`, and the `ResizeObserver` → `#measureRowHeight` path bails on `#hasRowHeightPlugin()`. Async rows (empty first render, data on a LATER render) burned it on an empty body → `state.rowHeight` pinned at the 28 default forever, while master-detail's `getRowHeight` compounds via `grid.defaultRowHeight ?? 28`. Symptom: 36px rows against a 28px cache → spacer short by `rowCount × 8px`, tail rows/detail panels unreachable. Tests: `variable-row-height.spec.ts > deferred base-height measurement with async data`.
- INVARIANT: successful deferred plugin base-height changes request VIRTUALIZATION, not just cache/spacer writes. Otherwise a 280px viewport retains thirteen rows from the 28px estimate after base/cache become 36px (eleven rows required), until unrelated input reconciles it. One-shot latch + changed-height guard prevent repeat-layout loops. `variable-row-height.spec.ts`.
- DECIDED (2026-10, mixed-height sticky sections): bypass force calls measurement-only `#measureRenderedRowHeights` before geometry reads/spacer writes; the virtualized wrapper retains its spacer update. WHY: ≤24-row mixed heights otherwise repeat the base estimate and shift StickyRows push boundaries. No ordinary-scroll measurement loop. `mixed-height-sections.spec.ts`.
- INVARIANT: measurement selects direct body rows and direct `.cell[data-row]`, validates canonical index, current window slot/cache bounds and `__rowDataRef`; nested grids, stale indexes and unindexed custom rows cannot populate another row's cache. Production never stamped the legacy fixture's `data-row-index`. `#resolveRowHeight` shares plugin→positive configured number/callback precedence between cache rebuild, measurement and invalidation; explicit `invalidateRowHeight(index, height)` wins.
- DECIDED (2026-10, detail height accounting): `resolveConfiguredRowHeight` resolves only the effective numeric/callback base. MasterDetail adds its measured/estimated detail once; no plugin dispatch or position-cache reads in base resolution (combined extents would recurse/double-count). Undefined/nonpositive retains `defaultRowHeight ?? 28`; collapsed rows defer to normal resolution. Tests: `master-detail-height.spec.ts` (integration + browser offsets/scroll).
- INVARIANT: MasterDetail settlement always delegates to `invalidateRowHeight`'s combined-extent comparison. `getRowHeight` can populate the detail measurement cache before the scheduled measurement; equality in that cache does not prove position-cache convergence.
- DECIDED (2026-10, configured-height anchoring): replacing `rowHeight` with a positive number/new callback captures one occurrence key + intra-row offset BEFORE config merge overwrites geometry; consumes ONCE after force-path cache/spacer rebuild, before window selection (bypass: after measurement). WHY: retaining old pixels loses the visible occurrence on density changes. `row-height-anchor.spec.ts` (integration + browser).
- INVARIANT: pending height anchor uses existing `getRowCacheKey` + scroll mapping, not another height/scroll cache. Coalesced changes keep the first capture; unchanged effective height, source-array/getRowId replacement, missing occurrence, newer pixel scroll, explicit navigation or teardown cancel. Clamp intra-row offset and new range; never write scrollLeft. Unchanged callbacks, ordinary forceLayout and removing rowHeight retain legacy behavior. Capped-coordinate roundoff must not select the preceding occurrence at an exact boundary.
- DECIDED (Aug 2026, batched variable heights): `measureRenderedRowHeights` collects rendered-row changes, then `updateRowHeights` sorts them and reconciles the affected position-cache suffix in one forward pass. WHY: calling `updateRowHeight` per visible row repeats the same O(n) suffix walk; 50 early updates on 100K rows measured ~55× faster batched. INVARIANT: final heights, measured flags, and offsets equal sequential updates; single-row callers keep `updateRowHeight`. Tests/bench: `virtualization.spec.ts`, `virtualization.bench.ts`.
  - INVARIANT (#467): BOTH `updateRowHeight`/`updateRowHeights` latch `measured = true` even when `heightDiff === 0`. WHY: `measureRenderedRowHeights` enqueues on `!currentEntry.measured`, so an early `heightDiff === 0` return leaves the flag false forever → the same rows re-measure + recompute `countMeasuredRows`/`calculateAverageHeight` every render pass.
- DECIDED (#326, `MAX_ELEMENT_HEIGHT_PX`): browsers cap element height ~33.5M px (Chromium 2^25) → spacer truncates above ~986 895 rows @ `rowHeight:34`. Clamp at `33_500_000`; `ScrollMapping` (`rawContentHeight`, `spacerHeight`, `viewportHeight`, `capped`) on `VirtualState`; helpers in `virtualization.ts`. 4 sites: `refreshVirtualWindow` + `grid.ts` scroll listener → `toVirtualScrollTop`; `focus-manager.scrollToRow` + `keyboard.ensureCellVisible` → `fromVirtualScrollTop`. Identity below cap; `tbw-scroll` + plugin `onScroll` stay NATIVE. Public: those 2 types + `computeScrollMapping`, `toVirtualScrollTop`, `fromVirtualScrollTop`. RULED OUT: fractional mapping below cap (loses pixel granularity). TENSION: above cap wheel/scrollbar skip rows; keyboard nav OK. Tests: `virtualization.spec.ts > Scroll Mapping Tests`, `scroll-mapping-cap.spec.ts`.
- DECIDED (Jul 2026, `refreshVirtualWindow` shape): dispatch only — `#renderUnvirtualized`/`#renderBypassWindow` short-circuit, then `#computeWindowStart` (binary search or `scrollTop/rowHeight`, zebra-parity round-down, plugin `_adjustPluginVirtualStart`) → `#computeWindowEnd` (always +3 overscan) → early-exit → transform/render/measure → `#scheduleSpacerRecalc`. INVARIANT: `#computeWindowStart` MUST read `s.positionCache` AFTER the force-path `initializePositionCache()` — hoisting reintroduces the stale-cache bug.
- INVARIANT (bypass force refresh): re-apply live `s.container.scrollTop`, never zero, except the one-shot configured-height anchor above. Order: render → initialize cache → measure rendered heights → read scrollTop/clientHeight → write spacer → apply anchor → write transform. Measurement must not write the spacer mid-path; clamp offset to `spacerHeight - s.cachedFauxHeight` in JS without rereading layout. Tests: `tiny-dataset.spec.ts`, `mixed-height-sections.spec.ts`, `docs-e2e/core.spec.ts > HeaderRenderersDemo — tall custom header`.
- DECIDED (Aug 2026, bypass `windowChanged`): `#renderBypassWindow` returns `force || s.start !== 0 || s.end !== totalRows`, NOT bare `true`. WHY: bypass renders every row so the window never changes on scroll; `true` made `#onScrollBatched` re-run `pluginManager.onScrollRender()` (expensive DOM queries) every frame on every ≤24-row grid.
- INVARIANT (diagnosing "bottom rows unreachable"): TWO modes — (1) spacer too short (`maxScroll < contentHeight - viewportHeight`), (2) transform desync (bar at max, `.rows` `translateY` doesn't follow). Spacer/`maxScroll` checks miss (2); ALWAYS also assert last row `getBoundingClientRect().bottom` vs viewport bottom AND `.rows` transform vs `.faux-vscroll.scrollTop`.
- DECIDED (Aug 2026, `#scheduleGeometryVerification`): every force `refreshVirtualWindow` schedules ONE rAF re-reading `viewportEl`/`scrollAreaEl` `clientHeight`; on drift re-requests `RenderPhase.VIRTUALIZATION`, capped at `MAX_GEOMETRY_VERIFY_PASSES = 3` per burst (reset on any non-correcting exit: match/bail/teardown). WHY: adapters commit header renderers (React portals, Angular embedded views) AFTER the scheduler's sync `_schedulerRenderHeader()` + `refreshVirtualWindow(true, true)` → header read at CSS min → `viewportHeightDiff` too small → short spacer (React 1069 vs 1202px, 133px stranded). RULED OUT: viewport `ResizeObserver` (collapse+restore nets zero in one frame), `#scheduleSpacerRecalc` microtask (pre-commit). Test: `tiny-dataset.spec.ts > recovers the spacer height when the header collapses only during the render frame`.
- DECIDED (Aug 2026, `--tbw-header-height`): presentation-only — sole in-repo consumer is `min-height` on `.header-row` (`core/styles/header.css`); `GridCSSVars.HEADER_HEIGHT` (`core/constants.ts`, `@since 0.1.1`) publishes the name only. Virtualization derives header allowance from live DOM (`scrollArea.clientHeight - rowsViewport.clientHeight`), never this var.
- DECIDED (Aug 2026, scroll-input extraction): `grid.ts#setupScrollListeners` keeps only wiring that needs `#private` state; three self-contained pieces extracted as free functions — `touch-scroll.ts#setupWheelScrollListeners` (wheel → faux scrollbar / scroll area; guards `select:open` in try/catch, `preventDefault()` ONLY when the axis can still scroll, so the page scrolls at the limit), `focus-manager.ts#setupFocusTracking` (focusin/focusout → `host.dataset.hasFocus`; external focus containers count as inside), `virtualization.ts#computeRowsTranslateY(v, totalRows, rawScrollTop)` (bypass → `-rawScrollTop`; virtualized → `toVirtualScrollTop` + even-aligned window start for zebra parity). INVARIANT: do NOT extract `#setupScrollListeners` wholesale — it touches ~18 `#private` members that would all become unmanglable seams.

## scroll-driven DOM state (cross-cutting plugin INVARIANT)

- INVARIANT: any plugin holding scroll-derived DOM state (`translateX`, sticky offsets, classes from `scrollLeft`/`scrollTop`) MUST apply it from **three** sites: `onScroll` (no afterRender while scrolling), `afterRender` (re-renders don't replay scroll), `afterCellRender` (pool recycling drops per-cell state). Symptom: correct at first paint, gone after sort/filter/scroll.
- DECIDED (#430): horizontal scroll dispatch to plugins is rAF-coalesced (`#hScrollRaf`), mirroring the vertical path — each dispatch forced layout (`scrollHeight`/`scrollWidth`/`clientHeight`/`clientWidth`); reads inside the rAF collapse to one per frame. Pooled `#pooledScrollEvent` still mutated in place.

## internal modules (`core/internal/`)

`rows` · `dom-builder` · `event-delegation` · `columns` · `header` · `keyboard` · `sorting` · `row-manager` · `focus-manager` · `row-animation` · `resize` · `touch-scroll` · `idle-scheduler` · `sanitize` · `style-injector` · `aria` / `aria-labels` · `aggregators` (sum/avg/min/max/count/first/last) · `value-accessor` · `tag-registry` (`GRID_TAG_NAME`, `get/setActiveGridTag`; leaf) · `column-shorthand` (`field="price:number"`, #276) · `inference` (`overlayInferred`, #384) · `empty` / `loading` · `virtualization*`

> `shell.ts`/`shell-controller.ts` live in `plugins/shell/` (#370).
> `sorting` · `row-manager` · `aggregators` · `value-accessor` are documented in grid-data-pipeline.md; `touch-scroll` (pointer side) in grid-input.md.

### sanitize

- INVARIANT: EVERY string a **user renderer** returns into `innerHTML` MUST pass `sanitizeHTML()`. NO opt-out config — do not add one. Covered: `rows.ts` (6 sites), `header.ts`, `empty.ts`, `loading.ts`, `dom-builder.ts`, `base-plugin.ts`, `context-menu/menu.ts`, `grouping-columns`, `master-detail.ts`, `shell.ts`. Grep `innerHTML =` before merging a new renderer — recurring miss = hand-written `string` branch beside a correct `HTMLElement` one.
- INVARIANT: **`setSanitizedHTML(el, html)` (`core/internal/sanitize.ts`) is the ONLY sanctioned way to put a computed string into the DOM** — sanitizes into a `DocumentFragment` + `replaceChildren()`; no parse→serialize→re-parse, so mXSS round trips are impossible. `sanitizeToFragment()` = fragment variant (append into existing content). `sanitizeHTML()` returns a STRING, kept only where needed (`shell.ts` `iconToString()`, toolbar templates).
- ENFORCED: ESLint `no-restricted-syntax` ([eslint.config.mjs](eslint.config.mjs)) fails the build on `X.innerHTML = <computed>` under `libs/grid/src/lib/**`. Allowed RHS: string literal, zero-expression template literal, `sanitizeHTML(...)`, `booleanCellHTML(...)`. Ignores specs/benches + `internal/sanitize.ts`. `math` ∈ `DANGEROUS_TAGS` (foreign-content mXSS gadget); `svg` allowed for icons.
- INVARIANT (Aug 2026 audit S3): `is=` ALWAYS stripped, right after the `DANGEROUS_ATTR_PATTERN` event-handler check — upgrades an allow-listed tag into a registered customized built-in, past the tag-name allow-list. Test: `sanitize-security.spec.ts > strips the \`is=\` attribute`.
- EXEMPTION (only one): `plugins/editing/internal/editor-injection.ts` assigns editor markup raw with an inline `eslint-disable-next-line`. WHY: sanitizer strips `input`/`select`/`textarea`/`button` — every editor. Editor strings are author code, not row data; `{{ }}` values are escaped by the compiled template. TENSION: column editor = code-trust boundary — do NOT make editor specs loadable from a remote/serialized source.
- DECIDED (audit 2026-08-07): `evalTemplateString` HTML-escapes `{{ }}` values via `escapeHtml`. WHY: template markup is author-controlled, row data is not; `sanitizeHTML` strips only _dangerous_ markup, so unescaped values allowed layout-breaking / overlay clickjacking. Escape the VALUES, never the template. Spec: `sanitize-security.spec.ts`.

### rows.ts (hot path)

- DECIDED (2026-10, utility views): keep the global column epoch; retain only a connected adapter-owned utility view with unchanged occurrence ID, visible field order and all effective options. WHY: legitimate sibling callback refresh must not detach an unchanged menu owner. `utility-view-retention.spec.ts`.
- OWNS: weak cell option snapshots taken on full builds, compared only on epoch rebuilds. Callback/primitive identity via `Object.is`; nested objects/arrays disqualify, except internal `__element` compared by declaration identity. No comparison on ordinary patches. Changed siblings rebuild; retained cell stays physically attached and receives fresh row + stamped processed index/hooks.
- INVARIANT: retention calls leaf `row-identity.tryResolveRowId`, not throwing public `getRowId` or `row-manager` (which imports `rows`). `row-manager` re-exports the shared helper for existing callers. Unkeyed rows rebuild; configured resolver errors propagate. No invented IDs or relaxed keyed-feature requirements. `utility-view-retention.spec.ts`; built calendar.
- INVARIANT: no retention for custom/synthetic rows, editor ownership, missing adapter opt-in or raw DOM renderers. True replacement/removal/recycling keeps `releaseControl` → adapter `releaseCell` teardown; batching detaches only released containers before `endBatch`. Vue/Angular retain conservative teardown until explicitly opting in.
- INVARIANT: RowManager marks every rendered cell of a mutated RowWindow row through `invalidateCellContent`, before `cell-change`; arbitrary renderer/accessor dependencies forbid field-name-only invalidation. Stable returned nodes/adapter containers update in place; untouched rows retain owners. Core invalidates its accessor cache even when a separately bundled plugin applied the write. Tests: `retained-row-mutation.spec.ts`, scoped-footer Add/Undo browser cases.
- INVARIANT: render/patch path decomposed into named private helpers — do NOT re-inline (was 100+/70+ cognitive). Patch: `syncRowPool` → `reconcileRow` → `patchPlainCells` → `patchCellContent` (pure dispatcher; branches write via `applyRendererOutput`/`applyTemplateOutput`/`applyFormattedValue` + ONE shared `emitAfterCellRender` — never duplicate the emit per branch) → `applyCellClass`/`applyRowClass`/`applyChangedClass` (via `clearDynamicClasses`+`applyDynamicClasses`, tracked in `data-dynamic-classes`) → `patchCellFocus` → `resetCustomRow`. Build (`renderInlineRow`): `clearRowForRebuild` (adapter `releaseCell` inside `beginBatch`/`endBatch`, #330) → `buildCellElement` → `renderCellContent` (→ `renderViaRenderer`/`mountExternalView`/`renderPlainValue`) → `scrubRenderedCell` → `applyCellTabIndex`.
- DECIDED (Jul 2026): per-cell patch helpers take **flat parameters, never an options object** — `patchCellContent` keeps 8 params on purpose. WHY: runs once per cell per patch; a context object allocates per cell. Cyclomatic/cognitive 8/10 after the dispatcher split (was 32/47).
- INVARIANT: `renderCellContent` and `patchCellContent` MUST keep the SAME precedence order (renderer → compiledView → viewTemplate → externalView → format/date/boolean/plain) — build and patch halves of one contract; divergence shows as a stale cell after scrolling.
- INVARIANT: `hasMissingExternalView` (attribute lookup, for `renderVisibleRows`) and `hasMissingExternalViewCell` (positional over `children`, for `fastPatchRow`) are deliberately TWO functions — do not merge.
- Regression gate: `rows.bench.ts` (`bunx vitest bench --run rows.bench`) — 3 scenarios × plain/rich columns. `render-pipeline.bench.ts` does NOT cover `rows.ts` DOM work. rme ~8–12 %; median of 3 runs.
- DECIDED (#430): `renderVisibleRows` guards the `aria-rowindex` write behind a `RowElementInternal.__ariaRowIndex` cache — pooled rows usually keep their index; the unconditional write cost ~40 wasted mutations/frame. Safe: only StickyRows else touches it (detached clones).
- DECIDED (Sep 2026): a `renderRow` hook returning `true` no longer skips `rowClass` — `renderVisibleRows` calls `applyRowClass` AFTER the hook, because custom renderers assign `className` wholesale (`ResponsivePlugin` → `'data-grid-row responsive-card'`) and would discard it anyway. Symptom was a consumer row highlight vanishing on the switch into card mode. Gated by `isSyntheticRow()` (`__isGroupRow`/`__loading`/`__pivotRowKey`/`__pivotIsGrandTotal`) — those markers are not `TRow`, so the callback must not see them. The gate is hook-path ONLY: the default path still calls `applyRowClass` unconditionally, so ServerSide `__loading` placeholders (no `__groupKey` → no plugin claims them) DO reach `rowClass`. `applyChangedClass` is deliberately NOT re-applied: custom rows own their chrome. e2e gate: `responsive.spec.ts > rowClass survives the switch into card layout`.

### columns.ts (track generation)

- `ColumnConfig.width` is a full CSS **grid track**, not a pixel number — `updateTemplate` emits strings verbatim (`'2fr'`, `'30%'`, `'minmax(120px,1fr)'`, `'calc()'`, `'min/max-content'`, `'auto'`, validated by `VALID_CSS_WIDTH`; a miss warns `INVALID_COLUMN_WIDTH` but still renders) and appends `px` to numbers. `width` wins in BOTH fit modes; the mode only picks the width-less track (`stretch` → `minmax(minWidth,1fr)` else `1fr`; `fixed` → `max-content`). `minWidth` is px-only (interpolated into `minmax()` + reused as the drag clamp).
- TENSION: a drag-resize commits a numeric px width and `__originalWidth` is only captured `typeof width === 'number'`, so non-px units are destroyed by the first resize and reset-to-original cannot restore them. `autoSizeColumns` skips any truthy `width`, so strings survive auto-size.
- There is NO `maxWidth` column property (a stale comment claimed `minmax(minWidth,maxWidth)` support; removed Sep 2026).

### resize.ts / DOM refs

- INVARIANT: `createResizeController(grid).dispose()` MUST fully unwind an in-flight drag — `onUp()` (remove window listeners, restore `cursor` + `userSelect`) AND `cancelAnimationFrame(pendingRaf)`. `grid.ts` recreates it in `#afterConnect()` + `#afterShellRefresh()`, disposing the previous instance first.
- `#cacheDomRefs()` = SINGLE place re-resolving hot-path refs (`_headerRowEl`, `_bodyEl`, `__rowsBodyEl`, `_virtualization.viewportEl`/`totalHeightEl`) from `.tbw-grid-content ?? .tbw-grid-root`, returning that root for `#setupScrollListeners()`. Called from `#afterConnect()` + `#afterShellRefresh()`; do not re-inline the querySelector block.
